notes.title: Minor patch - couple of quality of life features
notes.content:
Added options to change the colours of the bullets fired by enemies.
Added an option so that holding the button for Focus will fire without having to also hold the Fire button. Find this under Options-Keyboard and Options-Controller (the setting is shared between them).

notes.title: UI update and minor fixes
notes.content:
The UI for the left and right sides can now be reordered - if you want the score at the bottom and the cooldown at the top now you can! Or pick another configuration. Find this under [i]Options, In Game UI[/i].
Fixed issue where music wouldn't play under certain conditions when adjusting music volume.
Fixed issue for when the stock was set to show in the play area where the outline of the lives box wouldn't fade when the player moved over it in Timed mode - it does now.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content: Previous patch created a situation where sometimes a laser would last (seemingly) forever; lasers no longer last forever.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Further standardised the behaviour of lasers in slowmo.
Added an indicator to the game screen to show which mode is being played when the borders are turned off.
Added an indicator to the results screen to show which game mode was played.

notes.title: Minor update.
notes.content: Unintended laser behaviour fixed: firing time should be more consistent when coming out of slowmo.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Typo fixed. 
Leaderboard behaviour updated to not appear like there's no scores on them at all when a score hasn't been set by the player yet.
